selection_rationale: existing one-minute proposal and simulator interfaces support the complete lifecycle without downstream modification
long-only scope avoids narrowing or revising the frozen hypothesis
required inputs are limited to point-in-time price, volume, spread, volatility, and test-count evidence

specification.consolidation_rule: The five completed bars immediately before the trigger have total high-low width no greater than 0.75 times point-in-time ATR20.
specification.decision_window: 09:50 through 14:30 America/New_York using contiguous completed left-labeled one-minute bars from 09:30
specification.entry_rule: Existing shared proposal pipeline at the exact next one-minute bar open with zero permitted delay.
specification.integrity_rule: Duplicate, nonchronological, naive, nonfinite, nonpositive-price, negative-volume, negative-spread, mixed-symbol, mixed-session, or malformed-OHLC input fails closed.
specification.level_rule: Earliest maximum high among bars established at least 15 completed bars before the current trigger bar.
specification.missing_data_rule: Any missing required minute or unavailable point-in-time indicator prevents evaluation; no forward fill or interpolation.
specification.stop_rule: Fixed immediately preceding five-bar consolidation low minus 0.05 times point-in-time ATR20.
specification.target_rule: Fixed trigger close plus two times trigger-close-to-stop risk, calculated before entry.
specification.trigger_rule: Current completed close is strictly above the frozen level, current volume is at least 1.5 times prior-20 median volume, spread is at most 15 basis points, price is from 2 through 500 inclusive, and no more than two prior completed closes tested above the level.

reasons: candidate is directly falsifiable through the shared proposal pipeline
point-in-time synthetic inputs can prove every conformance path without empirical outcome access
